CustomField.description: Migration campaigns: the product offered in place of this hardware (e.g. Mi50 → Mi50.M). Set on the hardware product the Asset points to (Contract Hardware → Product). An "Offer" answer creates an Opportunity with one line per migration product, quantity = the customer's active 2G contracts on that hardware. Read by Svc_CampaignOffer.
